# SecretArea

> Explore Secret Area for verified PC game repacks, PS5 releases, Hypervisor tools, SteamTools, and software utilities with direct links and system specs.

SecretArea is a curated digital gaming and hypervisor resource platform providing high-speed direct downloads, repack guides, virtualization tools, and system utility catalogs.

## Core Features & Collections
- **PC Game Repacks & Patches**: Comprehensive library of PC game titles with install guides, system requirements, and verified mirrors (`/game/<title>`).
- **PS5 Releases**: Curated PS5 game catalog with firmware notes and details (`/ps5/<title>`).
- **Hypervisor Tools**: Virtualization setups, kernel drivers, and optimization suites (`/hypervisor/<title>`).
- **SteamTools & Utilities**: Community utility scripts, manifests, and library configuration tools (`/steamtools/<title>`).
- **Tools & Save Games**: Software suites (`/tools/<title>`) and 100% save game archives (`/savegame/<title>`).

## Key Links
- [Main Catalog](https://secretarea.site/): Browse top games, hypervisor utilities, and digital assets.
- [Dynamic Sitemap](https://secretarea.site/sitemap.xml): Auto-updating index of all game and resource title URLs.
- [Legal Compliance & Disclaimer](https://secretarea.site/disclaimer): Index policy, open-web compliance, and terms of service.
